name: hub-intel
description: Industry-hub platform band: copy-and-scene rows (floating images and soft glows) over a heading beside numbered feature cards. Live: #ap-gov-intel on the Government, Healthcare, Construction and Manufacturing hubs and #ap-eduhub-ursa on the Education hub (sheets and markup ported).

variant.description: gov: the Government-family hubs (#ap-gov-intel). eduhub: the Education hub (#ap-eduhub-ursa, stacks at 900px).

phone.description: Gov variant at 767px and below: scaled enlarges each scene 1.22x with extra space round it and a 56px row gap (live Government); plain keeps the scenes at size with a 48px gap (Healthcare, Construction, Manufacturing).

rows.description: Copy-and-scene rows. Each: title (required); eyebrow, title_accent (part painted with the brand gradient), body, links (each label, url), reverse (scene on the right), images (each image, x, y, w as % of the 546 by 364 scene; optional float, crop) and glows (each x, y, w, h in %, color as rgb/rgba).

features_eyebrow.description: Small label above the feature heading.

features_title_accent.description: Part of the feature heading painted with the brand gradient.

features.description: Feature cards. Each: title (required); body, icon (number badge image URL), icon_alt, accent (hex rule colour), link_label, link_url.
